---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new validator / country package
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who hits this today?

## Proposed solution

How you'd like it to work (API sketch is welcome).

```ts
// e.g. desired shape
import { foo } from "idvalidator-id";
foo.validate("…");
```

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about (or why existing validators don't cover this).

## Scope checklist

- [ ] New validator in an existing package (which domain?)
- [ ] New country package (`id-validator-<cc>`)
- [ ] Global / shared module (`packages/global/*`)
- [ ] Docs / examples / tooling only
- [ ] Other:

## Additional context

References (official specs, regulations, datasets) help a lot — especially for country-specific rules.
